investigation_notes.Script Summary: The decoded script defines a PowerShell function that checks whether a given target drive/path supports NTFS Alternate Data Streams and whether Add-Content supports the -Stream parameter, returning a boolean result. The logic enumerates local drives and inspects drive format (NTFS) and cmdlet availability.
